correctness.rationale: On (0,1/2), H(x)=a x(1−x), a=2(1−ε)∈(1,2) is increasing and maps lower half into itself; f(x)−x=a x(L−x) forces monotone convergence to L=(1−2ε)/(2(1−ε)). On upper half H(x)=b x(1−x), b=2(1+ε)∈(2,3), decreases and crosses the switch 1/2 once at c=(1+√(ε/(1+ε)))/2. For 1/2<x<c the image lies in (1/2,c), and c<x<1 maps lower immediately. Upper branch has U=(1+2ε)/(2(1+ε)). Factorization g(g(x))−x=−x(bx−b+1)[b²x²−b(b+1)x+b+1] has quadratic discriminant b²(b+1)(b−3)<0, excluding nonfixed period two; increasing g² iterates converge to U. Exceptional points 0,1 go to 0; 1/2 fixed by sign convention; c maps to 1/2, no nonfixed cycles. Uniform basin mass p=c−1/2; U−L=ε/(1−ε²); elementary two-atom moments yield claimed exact formula and Puiseux exponents. Independent symbolic and rational iteration tests corroborate boundaries/coefficients, not proof of all initial conditions.
